scenario: One ordinary POWER-on boot of an installed V1.2 system; serial output was observed separately from the display.
expected: The display shows a boot indication and the serial console reaches the installed NetBSD kernel.
observed: The operator confirmed that a boot indicator appeared during normal POWER startup. Separately, UART output reached SPL, OpenSBI, U-Boot 2026.10, FIT handoff and the NetBSD 11.1 ESP_MOSAICO_LITTLEFS_NOR #6 banner. Post-write verification separately reported a matching esptool hash for the FIT and for the LittleFS image; the digest values were not supplied for this record.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 unit and one normal POWER boot.
The report does not identify the displayed text, sequence, or whether every startup/rc line appeared.
No rc completion or login was confirmed.
The FIT and LittleFS digest values and exact build-source revisions were not supplied; this record does not pin them.
This result does not establish repeated-boot reliability or full startup completion.
